steps: Start aspirin 300 mg immediately (then secondary prevention).
Short-term dual antiplatelet (aspirin + clopidogrel) for ~21 days in high-risk TIA/minor stroke.
Urgent assessment (specialist within 24 h); carotid imaging - endarterectomy if symptomatic high-grade stenosis.
Anticoagulate if AF; high-intensity statin; control BP, diabetes, smoking.

confirm: Transient focal neurological deficit fully resolving (usually <1 h) without infarction on imaging. Risk-stratify (ABCD2) and image vasculature.
disposition: Urgent TIA clinic / admit if crescendo.
